  "code": "def rounded_avg(n, m):
    """For two positive integers n and m, determine the average of all integers from n to m, inclusive. Round the average to the nearest integer and express it in binary. If n is greater than m, the function will return -1.

    rounded_avg(1, 5) => "0b11"
    rounded_avg(7, 5) => -1
    rounded_avg(10, 20) => "0b1111"
    rounded_avg(20, 33) => "0b11010"
    """
    if n > m:
        return -1
    total = sum(range(n, m + 1))
    count = m - n + 1
    average = total / count
    rounded_average = round(average)
    binary_representation = bin(rounded_average)
